title: Real Estate Brokerage
duration: 30 hours of theory, 15 hours of discussion/practice, 90 hours of self-study

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, characteristics, role, and professional requirements of real estate brokerage.
Collect, analyze, and evaluate basic information about participants in real estate transactions.
Develop negotiation skills for real estate transactions.
Analyze various real estate transactions and apply them in practical situations.
Organize and implement real estate transactions effectively.
Handle legal documentation and procedures in real estate transactions.
Apply marketing principles to real estate transactions.
Continuously learn and improve professional skills independently.
Collaborate effectively within a team environment.
Think critically and solve problems in real estate transactions.
Work independently in new environments and situations.
